advent.label: Advent calendar
advent.description: From December 1st to 24th, every member opens one door a day and earns coins and/or an item.
advent.announce: 🎄 Day **{day}** of the Advent calendar is now open! Use `/advent open` to reveal your reward.

command.description: Advent calendar: open your door of the day.
command.open: Open today's door (or a specific day).
command.calendar: Show your progress in the calendar.

feedback.disabled: ❌ The Advent calendar is disabled on this server.
feedback.closed: 🎄 The calendar isn't open (only December 1st to 24th).
feedback.locked: 🔒 Day {day}'s door can't be opened yet.

calendar.title: 🎄 Advent calendar
calendar.testBadge: 🧪 **Test mode active** — every door can be opened (outside December too).

reward.title: 🎁 Door {day} opened!
reward.nothing: …but the door was empty this time.

announceChannelId.label: Announcement channel
announceChannelId.help: The channel where the bot announces each morning that a new door is open. Empty, the calendar still works — people just have to remember to come and open it.

defaultCoins.label: Default coins per day
defaultCoins.help: What a door pays when no reward is defined for it below. Saves having to fill in all 24 days before the calendar is playable.

testMode.label: Test mode (opens every door)
testMode.help: Opens every door outside December, to check the rewards before the 1st. TURN IT OFF before the real opening: left on, all 24 doors can be claimed at once.

g1.label: 🎁 Day-by-day rewards
g1.description: One row per door to customise. Days left out of the list give the default coins.

rewards.label: Custom doors

items.label: Items awarded
items.help: Item ids from the catalogue, one per bullet.

rewards.help: One row per day you want to customise; missing days fall back to the default coins. Items are named by their catalogue id — an unknown id is silently ignored, and the door only pays the coins. The quantity applies to each item on the row.

resetMyClaims.label: Reset my openings
resetMyClaims.help: Deletes only YOUR opened doors, so you can test the calendar again.
resetMyClaims.confirm: Erase your own opened doors on this server?
